Ahhhh interesting, the problem must have come from the linear uniform set code. Only Vulkan supports it, and Vulkan devices should always support it. But Metal doesn't support it AFAIK, so this is likely a limitation of MoltenVK.

> this is likely a limitation of MoltenVK.

I faced the same issue with vulkan on linux:  `Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2)`

`VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY` didn't happen when calling `vkCreateDescriptorPool` in the first few frames, which leads me to suspect there was a descriptor leak in the old version of the code.. maybe because it called `vkCreateDescriptorPool()` every frame?
